name: ChannelFlow-Jellyfin
description: Connects Jellyfin to ChannelFlow Server. Syncs library metadata, paths, and chapters, registers M3U/XMLTV Live TV, and runs commercial blackframe detection.
overview: Thin Jellyfin bridge for ChannelFlow Server — catalog sync, Live TV registration, and blackframe chapters
